capabilities: Sync Habitica personal and group tasks into a Markdown file grouped by type and source
Score vault tasks marked complete back to Habitica, creating missing tasks if enabled
Run automatic sync on a configurable interval per platform (desktop, mobile, or both)
Restrict syncing via machine binding and read-only modes (disable scoring or task creation)
Configure output folder, API credentials, and rate-limit handling with exponential backoff
extras: README warns the Habitica API token is stored in plain text in the vault and should not be shared; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or update Habitica tasks, so users must switch to the Habitica app to check off or score tasks.

relations.evidence: Sync your Habitica tasks with your Obsidian vault!

requires.name: Habitica API User ID and Token

summary: Two-way Habitica integration that pulls personal and group tasks into a Markdown file and scores completed vault tasks back to Habitica.
